proposal.hypothesis: From the current best measured configuration, reduce only print_mass_ref_kg from 0.10848926344219029 to 0.10 while holding side_m, wheel_mass_kg, wheel_radius_ratio, inner_radius_ratio, wheel_thickness_m, and all controller scales at their current-best values. Expected mechanism: a lighter printed frame lowers total mass and frame inertia, reducing gravitational restoring torque and actuator demand during vertex balancing. Because the current design already passes all numerical screening gates, this small mass reduction is intended to preserve completed status, contact, tilt, drift, slip, and speed-governor margins while improving the score components driven by final tilt RMS and torque-threshold exceedance. Success evidence would be all_screening_passed remaining true, especially status completed, peak_tilt_deg <= 5 deg, final_1s_tilt_rms_deg <= 2 deg, peak_pivot_displacement_mm <= 2 mm, contact_fraction >= 0.99, peak_slip_speed_m_s <= 0.05 m/s, continuous_torque_exceeded_fraction <= 0.1, and speed_governor_fraction <= 0.01, with a measurable decrease in mean_final_1s_tilt_rms_deg or mean_torque_threshold_exceeded_fraction.
